title: Prompt Like A Pro - The Prompt Tool That Asks Before It Writes
excerpt: Most prompt tools take one shot at whatever you typed. This one asks about your task first, then writes a ready-to-use prompt for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Midjourney. Free, no signup, nothing saved.
content_html:
Three reasons the questions are worth the thirty seconds.

Stop lazy prompts

Lazy prompt = lazy answer. A model answers what you typed, not what you meant. Supercharge your prompts.

Wording is worth 76 points

Reformatting the same prompt can swing accuracy by up to 76 points. Structure is not decoration.

Sclar et al., 2023

One draft, not five

Answer specific questions up front instead of rewording the prompt multiple times.

Before

The prompt

write a cold email for my saas thing, make it sound good and get replies

What you get

“Dear Sir or Madam, I hope this email finds you well. I am reaching out to introduce our innovative, cutting-edge solution designed to help businesses like yours…”

vague · generic · weak

After

The prompt

<role> senior B2B copywriter
<context> cuts onboarding time 40% for SaaS teams
<format> 90 words, one CTA
<tone> warm, specific, no fluff

What you get

“Hi Sarah, saw OnboardIQ just raised. Teams your size usually lose ~40% of trials to setup friction. We fixed that for Acme in a week. Worth 15 minutes?”

precise · specific · tight

Best-practice prompts, built with our own engine and ready for you to use. Copy one as-is, or customize it to your exact task in a click.

Explore the Prompt Library →

What is Prompt Like A Pro?

Prompt Like A Pro is a free AI prompt generator that asks before it writes. Most prompt tools take one shot at whatever you typed. This one asks a few clarifying questions about your specific task first, then writes a complete, structured prompt from scratch, built on prompt-engineering practices from Anthropic, OpenAI, and Google. It's an independently built, ad-free tool maintained by one person, with no signup required. If you find it useful, you can buy me a coffee to help cover the AI costs behind it.

Why does it ask me questions instead of just rewriting my prompt?

Because a one-shot rewrite can only work with what you already gave it. If your description leaves out the audience, the format, the length, or the constraints, a rewriting tool has to guess, and it usually guesses generic. The clarifying questions surface those missing details in about thirty seconds, so the finished prompt is right rather than merely longer. It's the same thing a human prompt engineer would do before writing anything: ask what you actually need.

Which AI prompt generator asks clarifying questions?

Very few do. Almost every prompt generator and prompt optimizer takes your text and rewrites it in a single pass, with no questions asked. The handful of tools that interview you first generally require an account and a paid plan. Prompt Like A Pro asks clarifying questions on every task, is free, and needs no signup.

How does Prompt Like A Pro work?

Describe what you want an AI to do, answer a handful of follow-up questions tailored to that task, and Prompt Like A Pro generates a complete, structured prompt you can copy and paste directly into ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, or any other AI tool.

Is Prompt Like A Pro free to use?

Yes. It's completely free to use, with no signup required and nothing saved. If you find it useful and want to help offset the AI token costs, you can buy me a coffee.

Do I need to create an account?

No. There's no signup or login. Just describe your task and start generating a prompt right away.

Which AI tools do the generated prompts work with?

The prompts are model-agnostic and work well with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Midjourney, and other AI tools, since they're built on prompt-engineering practices shared across the major AI labs rather than tuned to one model.

Is my data saved or stored anywhere?

No. Your task description, answers, and generated prompt exist only in your browser session and are never saved on our servers.

How is this different from other AI prompt tools?

There are three kinds of prompt tool. Prompt libraries hand you a pre-written template to fill in. Prompt optimizers and browser extensions rewrite whatever you paste in one pass. Prompt Like A Pro does neither: it asks about your task first, then writes the prompt from scratch based on your answers. That extra step is the difference between a prompt that is longer and a prompt that is right. It also costs nothing and needs no account, which the other interview-style tools generally do.

Who is Prompt Like A Pro for?

It's built for AI power users, content creators, writers, marketers, and anyone who regularly uses AI models and wants better results. It is used for writing assistance, coding help, marketing copy, resume improvement, academic research, AI image generation, email drafting, social media content, and deep research tasks.

What is Prompt Like A Pro?

Prompt Like A Pro 是一款免费的人工智能提示生成器，它会在写入之前进行询问。 大多数提示工具都会一次性执行您输入的任何内容。 这个问题首先会问一些关于您的具体任务的澄清问题，然后从头开始编写一个完整的、结构化的提示，该提示基于 Anthropic、OpenAI 和 Google 的提示工程实践。 它是一款独立构建、无广告的工具，由一个人维护，无需注册。 如果你觉得它有用，你可以请我一杯咖啡来帮助支付其背后的人工智能成本。

Why does it ask me questions instead of just rewriting my prompt?

因为一次性重写只能使用您已经提供的内容。 如果你的描述遗漏了受众、格式、长度或限制，重写工具就必须猜测，而且通常会猜测通用的。 澄清问题会在大约三十秒内显示出那些缺失的细节，因此完成的提示是正确的，而不仅仅是更长。 这与人类提示工程师在编写任何内容之前会做的事情是一样的：询问您真正需要什么。

Which AI prompt generator asks clarifying questions?

很少有人这样做。 几乎每个提示生成器和提示优化器都会一次性获取您的文本并重写它，并且不会提出任何问题。 首先面试您的少数工具通常需要一个帐户和付费计划。 像专业人士一样提示会针对每项任务提出澄清问题，免费且无需注册。

How does Prompt Like A Pro work?

描述您希望 AI 做什么，回答一些针对该任务量身定制的后续问题，Prompt Like A Pro 会生成完整的结构化提示，您可以将其直接复制并粘贴到 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Midjourney 或任何其他 AI 工具中。

Is Prompt Like A Pro free to use?

是的。 它完全免费使用，无需注册，也不会保存任何内容。 如果你觉得它有用并且想帮助抵消 AI 代币成本，你可以给我买杯咖啡。

Do I need to create an account?

不。无需注册或登录。 只需描述您的任务并立即开始生成提示。

Which AI tools do the generated prompts work with?

这些提示与模型无关，并且可以与 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini、Midjourney 和其他 AI 工具很好地配合，因为它们是建立在主要 AI 实验室共享的提示工程实践的基础上的，而不是针对一种模型进行调整。

Is my data saved or stored anywhere?

不会。您的任务描述、答案和生成的提示仅存在于您的浏览器会话中，永远不会保存在我们的服务器上。

How is this different from other AI prompt tools?

提示工具共有三种。 提示图书馆会为您提供一个预先编写的模板供您填写。 提示优化器和浏览器扩展会重写您一次性粘贴的所有内容。 Prompt Like A Pro 两者都不做：它首先询问您的任务，然后根据您的答案从头开始编写提示。 这个额外的步骤就是较长的提示和正确的提示之间的区别。 它也不需要花费任何费用，也不需要帐户，而其他面试类型的工具通常都是这样做的。

Who is Prompt Like A Pro for?

它专为人工智能高级用户、内容创作者、作家、营销人员以及任何经常使用人工智能模型并希望获得更好结果的人而构建。 它用于写作帮助、编码帮助、营销文案、简历改进、学术研究、人工智能图像生成、电子邮件起草、社交媒体内容和深度研究任务。
